Subject: Information only - change to your invoice layout

Dear customer,

Starting with the November invoice, the layout of your bill changes. The account number, the amounts and the due dates are unchanged. The new layout simply groups the services on one page.

This notice is for information only. No action is required from you, and there is nothing to confirm.
